## Drifted claim or surface
Identify the exact implementation behavior, machine-readable contract, or current document that is inconsistent.

## Current repository evidence
Cite the current revision and relevant paths. Use current implementation and active contracts rather than historical snapshots as present authority.

## Proposed reconciliation
Describe the minimum correction and all surfaces that must remain synchronized.

## Historical preservation
State which dated maintenance/snapshot artifacts remain immutable point-in-time evidence.

## Evidence boundary
State what is verified, inferred, missing, or not computed.

## Review and rollback
Define non-goals and the smallest rollback.
